 This Crl.P, Coming On For Orders, This Day, Order
Was Made Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mrs Justice M G Uma
Oral Order

The petitioner-accused No.4 is before this Court seeking grant of anticipatory bail in Crime
No.46/2024 of

Cubbon Park Police Station, on the file of the learned LXI Additional City Civil and Sessions Judge, Bengaluru, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 409, 420,
120B and 201 of Indian Penal Code (for short 'IPC'), on the basis of the first information lodged by the informant Mallikarjun.
2.

entities.text: Additional City Civil and Sessions Judge, Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard Sri. Ramachandra.H., learned counsel for the petitioner and Smt. N.Anitha Girish, learned High Court Government Pleader for the respondent-State.
Perused the materials on record.

3. In view of the rival contentions urged by the learned counsel for both the parties, the point that would arise for my consideration is:
NC: 2024:KHC:37539 "Whether the petitioner is entitled for grant of bail under Section 438 of Cr.P.C.?"
My answer to the above point is in 'negative' for the following:
REASONS 4.
Petitioner being accused No.4 is seeking grant of anticipatory bail on the apprehension of being arrested.

The Manager of Hitachi Cash Management Services Pvt. Ltd., Bangalore has filed the first information against accused No.1 making serious allegations that he was entrusted with huge cash of Rs.2.57 crores for the purpose of depositing it in the Bank.

entities.text: Hitachi Cash Management Services Pvt. Ltd., Bangalore
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Instead of depositing the cash in the Bank, he fled with the cash.
During investigation it is found that several other accused are also involved in committing criminal breach of trust and misappropriating the amount by cheating.
This petitioner is one such accused, who suspected to have actively involved in commission of the offence.
But till date, his presence could not be secured by the investigating officer.
Looking to the nature NC: 2024:KHC:37539 and seriousness of the offence, I am of the opinion that petitioner is not entitled for grant of anticipatory bail.

5. Accordingly, I answer the above point in the negative and proceed to pass the following:
ORDER Petition is dismissed.
